# Sansio

# Habit Tracker App

## 📌 Description

A simple web application to track daily habits and improve consistency.
Users can add habits, monitor progress, and stay consistent over time.

---

## 🚀 Features

* Add new habits
* Track daily progress
* View habit history
* Simple and clean interface

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

* Python
* Flask
* HTML, CSS

---

## 📂 Project Structure

```
habittracker/
│── app/
│   ├── routes/      # Handles app routes
│   ├── services/    # Business logic
│   ├── templates/   # HTML files
│   ├── static/      # CSS/JS files
│   ├── utils/       # Helper functions
│   └── __init__.py
│
│── run.py           # Entry point
│── requirements.txt
│── README.md
```

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Clone the repository:

```
git clone <your-repo-link>
cd habittracker
```

2. Create virtual environment:

```
python -m venv venv
```

3. Activate it:

* Windows:

```
venv\Scripts\activate
```

4. Install dependencies:

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

5. Run the app:

```
python run.py
```

---

## ▶️ Usage

* Open browser and go to:

```
http://127.0.0.1:5000
```

* Start adding and tracking habits
